WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales, SUM(r.receipts) AS receipts
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(r.receipts) AS receipts, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_week IN (7,8)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 3

WITH l AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, receipt_id, line_no, sale_date, net_amount, etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-29' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
)
SELECT 'rows' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS n, NULL AS amt FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup receipt_id+line_no', COUNT(*), SUM(dupes) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS dupes FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup sales_line_id', COUNT(*), NULL FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct etl_loaded_at (date)', COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)), NULL FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'web lines without order row', COUNT(*), SUM(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order w WHERE w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores_trading, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS web_net, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS store_net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END AS yr,
       o.status, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.line_count <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
       MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS first_order, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS last_order, SUM(o.order_total_gross) AS gross
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE (o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-05-25' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-06-24') OR (o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-05-31' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.closure_id, c.store_id, s.store_name, c.closure_type, c.closure_start_date, c.closure_end_date, c.weeks_closed
FROM ref_store_closure c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE c.closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28'
ORDER BY c.closure_start_date

WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')), net_lines AS (SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' UNION ALL SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'), weekly AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
